import os,json
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/home/appontrack/public_html')
paths=['mobile','mobile/updates','mobile/updates/native','saas','saas/mobile','saas/mobile/updates','saas/mobile/updates/native']
o={}
for s in paths:
 p=b/s
 o[s]={'exists':p.exists(),'symlink':p.is_symlink(),'resolve':str(p.resolve()) if p.exists() else None,'mode':oct(p.stat().st_mode&0o777) if p.exists() else None}
h=b/'.htaccess'
o['htaccess_legacy_update_rewrite']=('saas/mobile/updates' in h.read_text()) if h.is_file() else None
print(json.dumps(o,separators=(',',':')))
